claim_scope: For every integer r >= 36, an explicit Maynard-type symmetric test function in the simplex satisfies J_r(F)/I_r(F) > log(r)/(4r).
not_claimed: This is not a peer-reviewed replacement for Maynard, FGKMT, FMT, or Sono.
This does not close Maynard Proposition 6.1, the FMT good-sieve-weight moments, Hypothesis 1, PAP, UB, covering probability, or the x-to-X transfer.
The value 36 is the first r certified by this particular envelope-and-concentration contract; it is not asserted to be the mathematical minimum over all test functions.
No numerical X_cert or global minimum X_star is computed.

proof_partition.claim: The psi envelope gives explicit A, B, first-moment and second-moment bounds without an O-term.
Cantelli concentration on the first r-1 coordinates transfers the product-core bound to the simplex-supported F.
All integers 36 through 8103 pass the directed-interval formula; log(r)>=9 is covered analytically.
T1 SIV-06 is numerically explicit for r>=36.
The composed FMT good-sieve-weight package and X_cert are ready.
